existing.title: Invariant subspaces of bounded Hilbert-space operators
existing.statement: The intended question is whether every bounded operator on a separable infinite-dimensional complex Hilbert space has a closed invariant subspace other than \(0,H\). The de Branges--Rovnyak affirmative announcement was retracted.
existing.status: As of 12 November 2026, no generally accepted solution was verified in the literature checked. The unrestricted Hilbert-space problem remains distinct from its solved special classes and unverified claims.

incoming.title: Invariant subspaces of bounded operators on complex Hilbert space
incoming.statement: Does every bounded operator on a separable infinite-dimensional complex Hilbert space have a nonzero proper closed invariant subspace?
incoming.status: No generally accepted general solution was verified through 12 November 2026. A primary expert preprint of 21 August 2026 still explicitly calls this precise Hilbert-space problem unsolved. The 1964 announcement was retracted in 1965; unaccepted claimed proofs do not change the audited status.
